The '''Walker Festival''' was a bi-annual celebration on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Emmer]]. It was a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long festival filled with parades, feasts, and [[Walker/Legends|walker]] races.<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
